verdict.rationale: Rollbar's SDK docs and GitHub README confirm breadcrumbs via the 'telemetry timeline' feature and automatic person/user tracking to attach user context to errors, supporting the core of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of custom tag/context attachment beyond built-in fields, so the full 'custom tags' capability is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit custom tag/metadata API documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of combined breadcrumb+tag+user context on a single event.
